description:
Raloxifene 60mg — 30 Tablets (Generic for Evista®) is prescribed for the management of osteoporosis and related conditions affecting bone mineral density. Each unit is dispensed from our Cabo San Lucas pharmacy with full traceability of manufacturer batch and expiry.

Typical use involves a specific administration regimen, including hydration and posture instructions where applicable. Follow the timing and food-interaction guidance provided in the prescription leaflet. Consult your healthcare provider about complementary calcium and vitamin D intake.

Prescription Required. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1) before dispensing. Delivery available to homes and hotels across the Los Cabos corridor.
